nodes.label: Engagement-Goal Split (saves/shares/comments/follows mapping)
nodes.rationale: Pick the formula by what the post should earn first, then narrow by topic and surface.

nodes.label: IG10 - How-I Reel Teardown (reel)
nodes.rationale: Goal: saves. 'How I' beats 'How to' because first-person results carry proof; a tight, no-filler teardown is heavy save-bait.

nodes.label: IG1 - Number-First Result (caption)
nodes.rationale: Goal: saves. A hard, odd-precision number in the first 125 chars stops the scroll and promises a repeatable method; never invent the number, a challenged figure costs more reach than the post earned.

nodes.label: IG2 - Contrarian Truth (caption)
nodes.rationale: Goal: shares. A screenshot-ready, defensible opinion that cuts against common advice gets sent to friends and reshared to stories.

nodes.label: IG3 - Relatable Cold-Open (caption)
nodes.rationale: Goal: comments. A specific, shared moment with no setup earns instant recognition; specificity is the whole job since it's the most-copied genre.

nodes.label: IG4 - Mini-Story Confession (caption)
nodes.rationale: Goal: comments and follows. Transparency out-pulls polish; a real failure earns comments and the payoff line earns the follow, but it has to be true.

nodes.label: IG5 - Listicle Carousel (carousel)
nodes.rationale: Goal: saves. A numbered teaching carousel is the most-saved format; the 'most people miss number k' line opens the swipe loop, and the promise is a contract the middle slides must deliver on.

nodes.label: IG6 - Before/After Transformation (carousel)
nodes.rationale: Goal: saves and follows. Proof of transformation is the most credible hook; the gap between the after (slide 1) and before (slide 2) opens the loop, vague steps kill the save.

nodes.label: IG7 - Myth-Buster Carousel (carousel)
nodes.rationale: Goal: shares. Gives the reader ammunition to correct someone; naming a specific loss raises stakes, but a strawman myth reads as cynical and gets called out.

nodes.label: IG8 - Steal-This Framework (carousel)
nodes.rationale: Goal: saves. A named, repeatable framework feels like IP worth keeping; the single-slide summary at the end is pure save-bait.

nodes.label: IG9 - Pattern-Interrupt Reel (reel)
nodes.rationale: Goal: shares. Reel reach is decided in the first 1-3 seconds; a pattern interrupt plus open loop holds retention, but an unpaid-off hook causes a fast swipe-away the ranker reads as low quality.

nodes.label: publish_media_post() 3-Step Flow
nodes.rationale: Create-post (draft, no scheduledTime) -> get-upload-url + S3 PUT per file, in slide order -> update-post to status=scheduled + scheduledTime. This exact order is mandatory since a scheduledTime set up front would race Instagram's scheduler against the S3 upload. On any failure after draft creation, the draft is deleted so no broken post group with an abandoned upload is left behind.

nodes.rationale: Sends/shares rank highest, then saves and comments (esp. author reply), then reel watch time and profile-visit-to-follow; likes are low weight; negative signals (not interested, unfollow, hide, report) carry heavy penalty.

nodes.label: Algorithmic Note: Sends-Per-Reach & Saves Priority
nodes.rationale: Instagram's 2026 ranking leans on sends-per-reach and saves as the strongest spread signals, ahead of likes; the pre-publish test is whether a viewer would send this to one specific friend or save it for later.

nodes.label: Always-Forbidden Phrases (single hit scrubbed)

nodes.label: Em Dash Density Cap (~1 per 100 words)
nodes.norm_label: em dash density cap (~1 per 100 words)
nodes.rationale: The em dash itself is no longer a tell in 2026 (models use fewer than humans; 29% of human captions in the corpus contain one); density is the tell. Replace excess with comma, colon, parentheses, or line break, never a period. No en dashes between clauses, no double dashes.

nodes.label: AI Vocabulary Density Markers
nodes.rationale: One marker word per paragraph reads as English, two is borderline (flagged, left), three in one paragraph reads as AI and the whole paragraph gets rewritten (see ig-humanizer V3).

nodes.label: Brand Story (Catalyst/Core Truth/Proof narrative)
nodes.rationale: Business-challenge framing, not biography: the real test of a company's values is where they show up operationally, not what's claimed; B Corp certification is offered as the outside-audited proof of that test applied to her own company first.

nodes.label: Competitive Landscape (uniform/apparel sustainability space)
nodes.rationale: None of four researched competitor categories (uniform vendors, circular-economy consultancies, generalist ESG firms, PLM software) combine practitioner-operator credibility, no conflict of interest, a real origin story, and leadership/culture framing, which is the defensible gap Sarene's positioning occupies.

nodes.label: Positioning Statement
nodes.rationale: Values aren't just a moral stance, they're a business advantage; B Corp certification proves values were tested and verified rather than merely claimed, differentiating her from theorists in leadership/values speaking.

nodes.label: Topic Selection: the values-gap lane
nodes.rationale: Opening narrowly on whether stated values show up in practice (framed financially via turnover/trust/differentiation, not purely ethically) was chosen because opening broad would dilute the whole positioning; checked against passion, timeliness (ESG/greenwashing skepticism) and behavior-change filters.

nodes.label: lib.url_parser (Instagram URL Parser)
nodes.rationale: parse_instagram_url(url) returns {username, shortcode, url_type, canonical_url}; a carousel is detected from the media, not the URL, since it shares the /p/ path with a single image.

nodes.label: Core Pattern (Parse -> Draft -> Approve/Publish)
nodes.rationale: Every action-taking skill: 1) parse input (url_parser for Instagram URLs), 2) draft content applying 2026 research (hooks, hashtags, timing, voice, ranking heuristics), 3) wait for approval then publish with media via the Publora draft-upload-schedule flow.

nodes.label: Instagram/LinkedIn Co-Primary Platform Strategy
nodes.rationale: Confirmed against her live LinkedIn profile that she's already active and gaining traction there, and that's where her actual clients are. Instagram is the growth engine (reach/discovery); LinkedIn is where the strategy doubles down (heavier production, business-case-led content).

nodes.label: Self-Produced Solo-Hosted Podcast (Limited Series)
nodes.rationale: Direction changed from guest appearances on other shows to a self-produced, solo-hosted show released as five-episode limited series, one real lesson per episode. Three candidate series logged: Workplace Culture, Becoming a Certified B Corp, The Business Case for Values. Whether a co-host or recurring guest gets added remains an open, unresolved decision.

nodes.label: Proof Over Promise (renamed from Values Audit)
nodes.norm_label: proof over promise (renamed from values audit)
nodes.rationale: Renamed to spotlight a real company whose stated values visibly show up in what they do, or something she witnessed, instead of critiquing anyone. Needs a verified running list of real company examples from her own network before production; nothing gets named without her firsthand confirmation.

nodes.label: Weekly Shoot Day + Posting Cadence
nodes.rationale: One shoot day/week, 1-3 hours, producing 4-8 raw videos (roughly 17-34/month), set as a team decision. Posting cadence: daily, minimum 26 video + 4 non-video posts/month weighted toward reels, fed by podcast clips, keynote footage, and the weekly shoot day, which alone covers the minimum with room to spare.
